question.text: Under PIT regulations, violations involving mutual fund units must be reported to:

answer.text: The respective stock exchange(s), with amounts remitted to SEBI for credit to IPEF (Investor Protection and Education Fund) administered by SEBI
SEBI directly with amounts remitted to the Consolidated Fund of India
AMFI with amounts remitted to the concerned AMC
The RTA with amounts deposited in the scheme's corpus

explanation.text: The Logic: Insider trading code violations involving MF units are reported to the respective stock exchange(s). Any disgorgement amounts collected are remitted to SEBI for credit to the Investor Protection and Education Fund (IPEF) administered by SEBI. The Trap: The reporting goes to the stock exchange(s) (not directly to SEBI or AMFI), but the monetary amounts are routed via SEBI into the IPEF that SEBI administers - the IPEF is not maintained by stock exchanges. Note: IPEF (administered by SEBI under the SEBI Act) is different from IEPF (Investor Education and Protection Fund administered by MCA under the Companies Act). Do not conflate the two funds.
